name: rostech
description: Small mods for Claude Code, for working at a glance.

plugins.name: gas-gauge
plugins.description: A fuel gauge above the prompt: how much of your Claude plan is left, and when it refills.

plugins.name: speedometer
plugins.description: A speedometer above the prompt: how full the context window is, from 0 to MAX.

plugins.name: sticky-note
plugins.description: A note above the prompt that stays until you clear it.

plugins.name: radio
plugins.description: A chime when Claude finishes a long turn, so you can look away.

plugins.name: hands-off
plugins.description: Files you mark as yours: Claude cannot edit them until you hand them back.

plugins.name: odometer
plugins.description: An odometer above the prompt: how long this session has run and what it has cost.

plugins.name: clip
plugins.description: Put text on your clipboard from the prompt, cleaned of terminal clutter.

plugins.name: pop
plugins.description: Open a link or a file in its own window, straight from the prompt.

plugins.name: shot
plugins.description: Hand Claude the picture on your clipboard in one command.

plugins.name: pin
plugins.description: A short to-do list pinned above the prompt, ticked off with one click.

plugins.name: logo
plugins.description: Your own logo on the dash above the prompt, drawn in coloured blocks.

plugins.name: tach
plugins.description: A tachometer above the prompt: how fast you are burning tokens, over a window you choose.

plugins.name: valet-mode
plugins.description: A look-only mode for someone else at your PC: Claude can read and answer, but cannot change anything.

plugins.name: bumper-sticker
plugins.description: Your own words on the busy line while Claude works, in place of Baking, Brewing and the rest.

plugins.name: steering-wheel
plugins.description: Steer Claude mid-turn with one key. /steering-wheel sets F5 to send a waiting message right away, and the hint under the prompt says so.

plugins.name: glovebox
plugins.description: Keeps the notes that matter in the glovebox, and hands them back to Claude after it compacts its memory. Text notes only.
